To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the LMO invariant of a 3-manifold M is a formal power series with coefficients that are bounded by exp(O(N^4)) and the free energy of M is a Gevrey-2 power series with coefficients bounded by exp(O(1/N^2)).
the genus g free energy of a 3-manifold M is uniformly Gevry-1, hence convergent in a small neighborhood of 0.
the free energy and the number of cubic maps are analytic.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the asymptotic behavior of the LMO invariants of closed 3-manifolds, and the asymptotic behavior and convergence of the free energy.
the analyticity of the free energy of the LMO invariants.

the asymptotic behavior of the perturbative expansion of the free energy of the Chern-Simons path integral, and the number of rooted graphs with fixed genus and number of vertices, as the number of vertices goes to infinity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the free energy is Gevrey-0, but not Gevrey-2.
, in a neighborhood of the origin, the free energy is a Gevrey-2 series, and the genus g part is convergent for arbitrary genus.
the genus g perturbative invariant is analytic at zero, for all g.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide the asymptotics of all orders for the number of rooted cubic maps of arbitrary genus.
the free energy is a convergent power series for arbitrary genus, and that the asymptotic expansion for cubic graphs is given to all orders.
we have established the analyticity of the free energy of closed 3-manifolds, and we have also obtained the asymptotic expansion of the number of cubic planar graphs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the free energy is a very well-behaved object.
the free energy for a closed 3 manifold is an analytic function of the perturbation parameter.
the free energy is an analytic function of the gauge coupling, and that the genus g contribution is convergent for arbitrary g, independent of the topology of the 3-manifold.
